release_notes: Stability and usability follow-up to 0.9.9.0. Tables: light vertical column grid in the high-density Campaigns/Reports/Landers/Offers tables — headers, cells and the totals footer all share the divider system, and the Reports table now matches the tracker styling with its pinned name column fixed against sticky headers. Modals fit the screen at 100% zoom: the oversized overlay inset that pushed Save below the fold is gone, and the Affiliate Network / Traffic Source editors gained tabs (General / Parameters / Notes) with a pinned header and footer; the Landing editor is pinned too. Copy buttons work on plain-HTTP/IP installs (navigator.clipboard fallback to execCommand) — postback URL and macros in the network editor, integration keys, landing snippets. Campaign switch now stops real spend: pausing a tracker campaign can pause the linked Facebook campaigns / ad sets / ads through the Meta Marketing API (entities resolved from click parameters), the switch moved to its own Status column away from the campaign name, and a safety confirmation lists the ad entities before stopping them. Metric semantics: EPC/CPC redefined per LP click, new EPV metric with column hints in the customizer. Landing editor: required-field validation, ZIP re-upload, shared snippet components.
